programme.title: Heaven and Hell
programme.desc: Martial artistic mayhem is added to Dante's 'Inferno' with the bringing together of Alexander Fu, David Chiang and the Five Venoms!

programme.title: Return of the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: After Ah Niu gets out of jail, he gets involved again with his crooked Uncle Chou and caught in other rackets and silly situations.

programme.title: The 82 Tenants
programme.desc: If you liked House of 72 Tenants, you won't want to miss out on this humorous, fun-filled sequel complete with 10 more tenants!

programme.title: The Amorous Lotus Pan
programme.desc: Directed by Chow Sze Loke and Li Han Hsiang, this classic starring Diana Chang, Chang Chung and Pai Yun depicts how Lotus Pan marries a midget, yet has an affair.

programme.title: Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Director Ching Siu-tung won international acclaim for this tale of an underachiever who is assigned to unlock the secret of the gibbon fists tactic.

programme.title: Two Con Men
programme.desc: In this twisted comedy, a gambling game between a rookie con artist and an experienced flimflam man has life or death repercussions.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 3
programme.desc: Kuo Tsing's (Alexander Fu Sheng) adventures continue in Part 3 of this series of film adaptations of 'The Eagle Shooting Heroes'.

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: A stunning snake goddess in human form seduces a young scholar before a Buddhist monk breaks up their union.

programme.title: The Blood Brothers
programme.desc: A pillar of the Qing establishment kills his blood brother to steal the man's wife. Also starring David Chiang.

programme.title: The Empress Dowager
programme.desc: Lisa Lu stars as the dragon lady of the Ching Dynasty in this film that is full of palace intrigues and power games.

programme.title: The Killer
programme.desc: Starring Chin Han, Wang Ping and Tsung Hua, this movie revolves around the challenges that beset three sworn brothers and sisters.

programme.title: The Mirror and the Lichee
programme.desc: The film's curious title refers to two props that signal a happy beginning to what develops into a tragic love story, linking a scholar and a local beauty.

programme.title: Flying Guillotine 2
programme.desc: The Emperor develops a more deadly Flying Guillotine and trains a squad of women to combat the 'Iron Umbrella' and a band of rebels.

programme.title: Les Belles
programme.desc: Lauded as one of the greatest Hong Kong musicals of the 60s, this award-winning piece starring Linda Lin Dai as a dancer who finds romance with her boss's son.

programme.title: The Long Chase
programme.desc: The chase may be long, but the action is fast and furious, in this tale of a dart master-for-hire and the innkeeper's daughter who loves him.

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: A love rectangle lies at the heart of this romantic drama with an eve of World War II setting. Starring Kwan Shan, Li Ting.

programme.title: Return of Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: Tu Ku, having mastered the Silkworm skills, heads for Wu Tang to challenge Yun but finds him gone. However, the leader of the Ega Clan issues a challenge.

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: Kung fu idols Wang Yu, Lo Meng and Loh Lieh star in this comedy set in a Shaolin temple where Hung Hsi-kuan and Fang Shih-yu become disciples.

programme.title: To Kill a Jaguar
programme.desc: In this twist-filled action film, a country girl is saved by a hero and remains coveted by her jilted lover.

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: Attracted by a sensual rain dance performed by three tribeswomen, three snake siblings set in motion a tale of romance, lust and tragedy.

programme.title: The Enchantress
programme.desc: A wanna-be-detective/swordsman gets more than he bargained for when investigating the disappearance of some martial artists.

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: The court intrigues, politicking, bickering and backstabbing continues in this sequel to The Empress Dowager. Starring Lisa Lu.

programme.title: The Chinese Boxer
programme.desc: A Chinese martial arts student (Wang Yu) trains hard to defeat the karate expert (Lo Lieh) who brutally killed his master and peers.

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: A chauffeur's daughter and the heir to a cruise ship conglomerate fall in love as they try to outwit greedy relatives who have sights on the company.

programme.title: The Mighty One
programme.desc: The famed Ivy Ling Po plays a mysterious swordswoman, who teams up with the Roving Knight in a battle against a string of intimidating villains.

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: This heartwarming 1963 musical from Shaw Brothers tells the tale of a beautiful shepherdess, whose own problems drag her into a love triangle.

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre 2
programme.desc: In Part 2 of this adventure, only the title weapons' union can save the 6 remaining sects which vie for mastery of the martial world.

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: After a young mother and her husband die, one child is sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: That Fiery Girl
programme.desc: Death and destruction are the order of the day after a bandit's daughter learns some painful truths about her past.

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: Set in the Han Dynasty, this drama depicts the legendary beauty Diao Chan, and how she used her charms to help her godfather eradicate corrupt court officials.

programme.title: Facets of Love
programme.desc: In this king of epic dramas, three sexy vignettes are set against a Ming Dynasty brothel that steams with erotic myths, secret trysts and pleasurable twists.

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: The Monk, Monkey, Friar Sand and Pig find themselves in a realm where women can only give birth to women unless loved by a man.

programme.title: The Lark
programme.desc: 60s pop star Carrie Ku Mei plays pop star 'Little Lark' in her greatest role, in this romance that features some of the most popular Mandarin songs of all time.

programme.title: Heroes Two
programme.desc: Shaolin loyalists (led by Alexander Fu Sheng and Chen Kuan Tai) go up against a formidable Manchu general and his Tibetan allies.

programme.title: Forever and Ever
programme.desc: Huangmei Opera queen, Ivy Ling Po stars in this tale of a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter a girl who is dying.

programme.title: The Spiritual Boxer
programme.desc: A young man and his sifu earn a living as pseudo-ghost catchers until his sifu is arrested and an honest gal becomes his new companion.

programme.title: The Pearl Phoenix
programme.desc: This gender-bending tale depicts the romance between a wealthy girl and a man disguised as a flunkey in order to be employed at her house.

programme.title: The Lizard
programme.desc: A Robin Hood-like burglar must outwit the corrupt police chief who seeks to unmask him. Starring Yueh Hua, Connie Chan Po Chu.

programme.title: Gossip Street
programme.desc: Regular Joes turn heroes to save their neighbourhood, when a local mobster decides to turn their local gossip spot into a gambling den!

programme.title: The New One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: A swordsman (David Chiang) is moved to fight back after the love of his life is kidnapped and his best friend murdered by a gang.

programme.title: The Big Sting
programme.desc: Director Lu Chun-ku leads Liu Yung, Liang Yun-hsin and 'Thundering Mantis,' Liang Chia-jen on a madcap quest filled with double crosses and triple plots.

programme.title: Secret Service of the Imperial Court
programme.desc: A secret service agent, Chao Pu Fun, must protect the innocent against a power-mad Eunuch.

programme.title: Intimate Confessions of a Chinese Courtesan

programme.title: Bat Without Wings
programme.desc: Three swordsmen's search for the murderous Bat Without Wings brings to light a plethora of criminal individuals and twists in the tale.

programme.title: The Black Enforcer
programme.desc: When Lung, the Black Enforcer, is forced to house a killer named Fei during a snowstorm, Fei's gang comes for him. Fei kills Lung's mother and sister, triggering a fearsome vendetta.

programme.title: Love With the Perfect Stranger
programme.desc: Pauline Wong plays a pregnant student who marries a sympathetic, yet equally heartbroken, passer-by in Jamie Luk's directing debut.

programme.title: Crippled Avengers
programme.desc: Chang Cheh presents this ultimate depiction of dysfunctional kung fu masters, overcoming their shortcomings to win the day, one corpse at a time.

programme.title: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung

programme.title: The Daredevils
programme.desc: Director Chang Cheh teams up with the Five Venoms in this martial arts saga that captures the fab five at their swashbuckling best.

programme.title: Three Sinners

programme.title: Clan of Amazons
programme.desc: This action-packed adventure centres on a mysterious masked highwayman who not only steals from the rich but also blinds them!

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: In this adapation of a Qiong Yao novel, a young woman finds lust, trouble, and, finally, happiness at a picturesque farm.

programme.title: The King Boxer
programme.desc: This drama captures the legend of a young boxer who battles the odds to become the ultimate fighter in a tournament against his greatest rivals.

programme.title: The Singing Escort

programme.title: Shaolin Abbot

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Three single females and the men they fall for think things are simple and blissful until the lasses' parents enter into the picture.

programme.title: Magnificent Wanderers

programme.title: The Female Prince
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po and Chin Han return with a Huangmei Opera classic, depicting a loving couple whose marriage is being poisoned by the husband's stepmother.(n)

programme.title: The Pirate

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: In this 'Brave Archer' sequel, Kuo Tsing's (Alexander Fu Sheng) love for Huang Yung (Niu Niu) is challenged by Ouyang Fung.(n)

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches

programme.title: The New Shaolin Boxers
programme.desc: Alexander Fu stars as a young carriage driver who finds love and encounters peril after he rescues a girl from being harassed by a dangerous group.(n)

programme.title: Pale Passion

programme.title: Invincible Shaolin

programme.title: The Three Smiles

programme.title: King Cat

programme.title: Tragic Commitment

programme.title: The Vengeful Beauty

programme.title: Puppy Love

programme.title: Hikayat Batu Belah Batu Bertangkup

programme.title: Hikayat Batu Belah Batu Bertangkup
programme.desc: Melur dan adiknya Pekan terpaksa tinggalkan kampung selepas kematian ibu mereka ditelan Batu Belah Batu Bertangkup. Mereka bertemu Nek Yan dan Toktok yang mengajar mereka ilmu bertahan hidup dan silat.(n)

programme.title: Hikayat Batu Belah Batu Bertangkup
programme.desc: Pekan terpilih untuk jadi wakil kampung ke pertandingan pahlawan diraja, dan Melur tidak berpuas hati kerana tidak dibenarkan bersaing. Pekan berdepan dengan peserta misteri yang sama handal.(n)

programme.title: Hikayat Batu Belah Batu Bertangkup
programme.desc: Melur dan Pekan ditahan akibat bergaduh di hadapan Raja. Raja jatuh sakit. Melur cuba untuk tolong mengubat Raja.(n)

programme.title: Hikayat Batu Belah Batu Bertangkup
programme.desc: Pekan nekad musnahkan Batu Belah Batu Bertangkup. Melur dipilih untuk tugasan itu tapi enggan, lalu Pekan pergi sendiri dengan bahan letupan. Toktok menemani. Pekan berjaya letupkan Batu Belah.(n)

programme.title: Hikayat Pak Belalang
programme.desc: Belalang terjumpa binatang belaan yang dicuri lalu dapat idea untuk jadikan Pak Belalang seorang nujum.Sultan Rimbun Beringin susah hati apabila nujum negara meninggal lalu terdengar tentang Pak Belalang.(n)

programme.title: Hikayat Pak Belalang
programme.desc: Pak Belalang cuba melarikan diri apabila terjumpa harta yang dicuri, menyebabkan dia dilantik menjadi nujum negara. Puteri Bujur Sirih mendekati Pak Belalang dan Belalang untuk mengetahui kebenaran.(n)

programme.title: Hikayat Pak Belalang
programme.desc: Belalang dan Hijau cuba mendapatkan kertas manifesto sehingga Hijau cedera. Puteri bantu Pak Belalang untuk berdebat. Belalang dan Puteri diculik Sultan Pasir Berdengung.(n)

programme.title: Hikayat Pak Belalang
programme.desc: Pak Belalang cuba selamatkan Belalang dan Puteri dengan bantuan Hijau sehingga membahayakan nyawanya sendiri. Rahsia Pak Belalang akhirnya terbongkar.(n)

programme.title: Hikayat Bawang Putih Bawang Merah
programme.desc: Akibat setiap hari didera oleh ibu tiri dan adik tirinya, Bawang Putih melarikan diri ke dalam Hutan Larangan tempat Pari-Pari jahat. Putera pula dalam usaha mencari calon Permaisuri.(n)

programme.title: Hikayat Bawang Putih Bawang Merah
programme.desc: Putih bertemu dengan Pari-Pari yang rupanya baik hati. Pari-Pari mahu menjodohkan Putih dengan Putera Raja. Putih dan Putera bertemu, dalam keduanya cuba mencari takdir untuk diri mereka sendiri.(n)

programme.title: Hikayat Bawang Putih Bawang Merah
programme.desc: Putera mencari Putih dengan mengadakan acara ujibakat nyanyian. Putih pula mahu dibunuh oleh Belitong sementara Bawang Merah, si adik tiri Putih mahu menyamar sebagai Putih untuk merampas Putera darinya.(n)

programme.title: Hikayat Bawang Putih Bawang Merah
programme.desc: Terperangkap di dalam sangkar, Putih akhirnya dapat tahu siapa sebenarnya yang membunuh ibunya. Putih berdepan dengan Mak Kundur dan menamatkan deritanya buat selama-lamanya.(n)

programme.title: Hikayat Batu Belah Batu Bertangkup
programme.desc: Pekan nekad musnahkan Batu Belah Batu Bertangkup. Melur dipilih untuk tugasan itu tapi enggan, lalu Pekan pergi sendiri dengan bahan letupan. Toktok menemani. Pekan berjaya letupkan Batu Belah.(n)

programme.title: Hikayat Batu Belah Batu Bertangkup

programme.title: Legenda Puteri Qaseh
programme.desc: Qaseh, seorang penjual nasi lemak di Kayajaya bersama temannya, Laila, terkejut melihat abahnya, Hidayat, ditangkap kerana mencuri. Ketika cuba menyelamatkan Hidayat, sebuah rahsia besar terbongkar.(n)

programme.title: Legenda Puteri Qaseh
programme.desc: Qaseh melakukan banyak kesilapan sewaktu dilatih Cik Seri Lee Za. Laila gagal membayar sewa dan Qaseh membantunya secara rahsia. Rahsia itu terbongkar, mengakibatkan Qaseh dilarang keluar istana.(n)

programme.title: Legenda Puteri Qaseh
programme.desc: Hidayat ditangkap sekali lagi kerana menyerang Andika akibat salah faham. Qaseh terpaksa berdepan dengan dilema antara tugasnya sebagai seorang puteri dan kesetiaannya sebagai seorang anak.(n)

programme.title: Legenda Puteri Qaseh
programme.desc: Qaseh cuba membantu peniaga Pasar tetapi Raja Sulong mengelirukannya dengan pelbagai teori ekonomi. Kerana tekanan daripada segala sudut, Qaseh tekad untuk meninggalkan takhtanya sebagai Puteri Mahkota.(n)

programme.title: Legenda Puteri Qaseh
programme.desc: Qaseh dan teman-temannya membuat perancangan untuk menakutkan pelabur dan menghentikan pelan menaik taraf Pasar. Dengan bantuan dari dalam Istana,mereka berjaya,lantas menimbulkan kemurkaan Raja Sulong.(n)

programme.title: Legenda Puteri Qaseh
programme.desc: Qaseh mendengarkan sejarah hidup dan kemangkatan ibubapa kandungnya daripada Tabib Chan dan mengesyaki pendirian mereka yang mementingkan keadilan telah mengakibatkan tragedi kemangkatan tersebut.(n)

programme.title: Legenda Puteri Qaseh
programme.desc: Qaseh dan Laila tidak dapat berniaga kerana pasar ditutup. Mereka membantu Tabib Chan merancang pencarian Lee Za dan Hidayat di Istana. Pelan mereka berjaya, namun tidak semua yang dapat melarikan diri.(n)
